name: Johnny Cash

features.name: Sticky wilds in free spins
features.description: Wilds lock until the end of the bonus.

features.name: Retriggers
features.description: Three or more scatters in the bonus add more free spins.

review:
A Wild West cowboy chasing gold on a 5x3, 20-line grid. The wild covers everything except the scatter.

Three scatters give 10 free spins, which can retrigger, and in the bonus every wild locks in place until the end – so a couple of early wilds can keep paying spin after spin. Medium-high volatility, 2,077x max and 95.98% RTP, with free spins about once every 157 spins. A straightforward sticky-wild game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
